scope: Read-only catalogue and production-engine audit; proposed designs are not implemented or qualified.

navigation.problem: Fresh default stays in48-level Classic; first18missions have stationary prey, moving quarry starts19th. New field campaigns require explicit picker choice and each v4chapter ends its owncampaign. LivingRoutes is first in campaign list although defaultbelongsClassic.
navigation.featuredProblem: Every chapter featured entry is blindly index5, including SignalTactics10 and FieldMastery8. Broadcast, jammer+lane and late finales are not exposed by that slot.
navigation.proposal: Preserve defaultOpenLoop, directlinks and savedselection. Add one explicit24mission TacticalExpeditions campaign covering allfournewchapters in order and feature it visibly in ChooseMission. Use authored featuredmission IDs. Offer the newcampaign at oldcampaign finales without silently switching campaigns.

findings.fact: v4 spawn uses p.at?[p.at]:path/freecells; requiredpolicy is spawnedRequired%required.length. Fixed posts must be unoccupied and>=4 path cells from every head. Same station cannot appear elsewhere; player must leave then return.
findings.impact: Short fixed lists plus highgoals repeat catches at identical coordinates; queued refill may leave no target while old station is unsafe.

findings.fact: QuietReturn has maxActive1; jammer and runner never coexist. All PatrolFrontiers missions maxActive1. Most mixedlists mean sequential enemies only.
findings.impact: Mechanic descriptions can imply tactical combination without concurrent decisions; localjammer mastery cannot demonstrate obscured ordinaryprey.

findings.fact: OpenSeam, SeamReturn and FieldLinks reuse11,8 eroder with only12,8 markedwall. removedWalls persists across respawns.
findings.impact: Later eroders have no new wall to open; repeatcatch adds length but no new routechange.

findings.fact: Every v4mission has no pickups, shutters or wrap; all sharethe same playerstarts.
39/48v1missions have one stationarytarget; goals8..20, with18consecutive stationarymissionsfirst.
findings.impact: Do notbreakoldrecipes tofixdiscovery. Promote new authoredmissionchoices and keepClassic as explicit backcatalogue.

revisions.problem: maxActive1 means jammer and runner never coexist; the named mastery cannot hide an ordinary runner during a burst.
revisions.change: Use maxActive2 and an alternating six-row schedule: local postA, runner, local postB, refuge, local postC, switchback. Distinct posts and goal6.

revisions.problem: Four catches repeat two emitters on the same horizontal lane.
revisions.change: Teach one horizontal crossing and one vertical crossing at distinct posts; goal2 or3, permanent bypasses for every lane.
revisions.history: new revision; archive exact current recipe

revisions.problem: Sequential lane/runner/lane repeats the same row; no simultaneous interception choice.
revisions.change: Two targets, a runner plus a horizontal emitter first, then a different vertical emitter and refuge; goal4.
revisions.history: new revision; archive exact current recipe

revisions.problem: Six catches use only two stationary posts; proof catches the same jammer three times.
revisions.change: Keep the interference/lane introduction but rotate through three distinct source/lane station pairs, with one ordinary prey between pairs; goal6 and no station reuse.
revisions.mechanics: existing explicit policy rows; full lane safety qualification

revisions.problem: After the single marked cell opens, the same eroder respawns with nothing left to open.
revisions.change: One eroder then one runner; goal2. Make the opened one-cell wall a meaningful shortcut with a permanent longer bypass.

revisions.problem: Three eroder catches reuse the same post and already-open marked wall.
revisions.change: Two eroders at different thin-wall notches, each followed by ricochet or refuge prey; goal4; both openings create distinct later routes.
revisions.history: new revision; archive exact current recipe

revisions.problem: Four guard catches repeat two horizontal firing posts.
revisions.change: Three unique posts with different headings and clear side approaches; goal3.
revisions.history: new revision; archive exact current recipe

chapters.title: Crossing Routes
chapters.purpose: Interception, alternate approaches and body routing before adding strong hazards.

chapters.title: Changing Shortcuts
chapters.purpose: Choose timed shortcuts, supplies, optional couriers and opened terrain.

chapters.title: Hidden Signals
chapters.purpose: Actual moving prey and trailing cable under local or broadcast information loss.

chapters.title: Expedition Circuits
chapters.purpose: Short multi-stage encounters with distinct stations and multiple safe approaches.

missions.title: Orchard Fork
missions.geometry: Two unequal islands form a short middle cut and broad outside loop.
missions.decision: Take the patrol shortcut or turn toward the runner; preserve a return around the larger island.
missions.variation: Two different patrol circuits alternate; no fixed post.

missions.title: Switchback Courts
missions.geometry: Staggered U-shaped courts have opposite open ends and a central cross-connection.
missions.decision: Read the announced goal and approach its exit, instead of entering the same court behind the target.
missions.variation: Four authored goals, distinct inner/outer return lengths.

missions.title: Opposite Platforms
missions.geometry: A long divider ends in two wide turning platforms.
missions.decision: Intercept one partner, then route safely to the surviving runner; Team can divide the two approaches.
missions.variation: Pair-only shared waypoint set; no incompatible specialist or courier.

missions.title: Boundary Exchange
missions.geometry: Two edge-reaching walls leave a wrap shortcut and a longer visible central bypass.
missions.decision: Use the wrap seam to get ahead of moving prey, accounting for the returning tail.
missions.variation: Different path from existing universal outer patrol; one short edge circuit.

missions.title: Mirror Returns
missions.geometry: Offset vertical and horizontal baffles make three reflection straights with open corners.
missions.decision: Predict a reflected return while the other target signals its next corner.
missions.variation: Alternate ricochet headings rather than all-right policies.

missions.title: Inner–Outer Transfer
missions.geometry: Two small islands with separate contour loops and a short optional shutter crossing.
missions.decision: Choose which moving circuit to intercept and whether the shutter saves enough distance.
missions.variation: Different contour path per policy; permanent route when shutter closes.

missions.title: Shutter Split
missions.geometry: An offset divider has one timed inner gap and two permanent long returns.
missions.decision: Commit to the short opening or start the safe outside intercept before a sprint.

missions.title: Pulse Detour
missions.geometry: Three islands create a safe wide route and a supply spur away from the shortest chase.
missions.decision: Spend distance reaching Pulse to freeze a difficult intercept, or catch the target directly.
missions.variation: Supply pads on the optional spur, not directly on the normal route.

missions.title: Tail Workshop
missions.geometry: A figure-eight of wide lanes narrows at one shortcut, with roomy turning areas at both ends.
missions.decision: Wait for the brace opening or collect Reel to free the short route from the growing tail.
missions.variation: Tail pressure changes the best route after early catches.

missions.title: Courier Overpass
missions.geometry: Two staggered cross-connections join a long patrol ring; courier route crosses the tempting shortcut.
missions.decision: Take an optional courier interception without blocking the required target return.
missions.variation: Goal10 allows both existing courier offers; bonus catches remain optional.

missions.title: Breaking Bridge
missions.geometry: A thin divider has two separately marked removable notches and a permanent outside bypass.
missions.decision: Catch the first eroder now or let it open a useful return; the second notch changes a later approach.
missions.stations: Two different eroder posts and marked cells; each appears once.

missions.title: Clockwork Intercepts
missions.geometry: Offset paired shutters connect three yards; both closed still leaves a continuous outside route.
missions.decision: Time a flank through one gate while preserving room for the second return.
missions.variation: Gate phases differ; supplies serve different route choices.

missions.title: Edge of Reception
missions.geometry: A local antenna overlooks one shortcut while the other side of an island stays outside six-cell coverage.
missions.decision: Enter interference for a short intercept or leave the circle to track the moving prey clearly.
missions.stations: Three distinct posts; each paired with ordinary moving prey.
missions.requiredEvidence: A normal proof must contain an active burst with ordinary prey outside all protected head neighborhoods.

missions.title: Blind Bend
missions.geometry: A bent divider gives a short covered corner and a longer clear flank between four goal bays.
missions.decision: Read the next announced bay before entering the burst, or intercept from clear ground.
missions.stations: Two different posts; target goals on opposite flanks.
missions.requiredEvidence: Show a route decision during real simultaneous jammer/prey exposure.

missions.title: Moving Shadow
missions.geometry: An asymmetric patrol ring has two inner cuts and a long exposed far side.
missions.decision: Remember the distant moving patrol through a warned broadcast, then take its next cut.
missions.stations: Three distinct source stations; avoid refilling one antenna repeatedly.

missions.title: Quiet Relay
missions.geometry: Two relay courts connect around a narrow central island; source sits on a third approach.
missions.decision: Disable the source first or visit the clearly marked relay pads while keeping track of the returning cable.
missions.stations: One source, one relay core, distinct pad pair; no lethal lane.

missions.title: Clear Ground
missions.geometry: Wrap board with a side antenna, one edge-reaching baffle and a visible far-edge recovery route.
missions.decision: Cross the seam to escape coverage, or collect Pulse to keep the short intercept stable.
missions.stations: Three separated source posts; wrapped coverage explicitly taught.

missions.title: Radio Chase
missions.geometry: Two staggered islands produce a changing long-tail crossing and separate source approaches.
missions.decision: Choose between ending a broadcast, keeping an intercept, and taking Reel before the cable fills the crossing.
missions.stations: Each of three source posts appears once; subsequent moving prey changes the finish.

missions.title: Outpost Circuit
missions.geometry: Four irregular yards have guards facing different open corridors and permanent side approaches.
missions.decision: Approach each guard from a different safe flank while opportunistically catching moving prey.
missions.stations: Four distinct posts/headings, never the same horizontal pair repeated.

missions.title: Crosswind Gates
missions.geometry: One horizontal and one vertical marked lane divide broad connected courtyards with end bypasses.
missions.decision: Watch which crossing is recovering and choose the corresponding long or short return.
missions.stations: Three distinct lane posts and orientations; validate bypass even if two lanes overlap in time.

missions.title: Relay Islands
missions.geometry: Three islands separate two relay core circuits with different pad pairs and an optional center shutter.
missions.decision: Select the next pad route before growth closes the shortest return; Team can divide pad approaches.
missions.stations: Two unique core/pad arrangements; each core appears once.

missions.title: Waking Junction
missions.geometry: An off-center crossroads joins a wide safe loop and an island contour with an open side flank.
missions.decision: Wake the rover from the route you want it to take, then flank the shield or intercept the contour.
missions.variation: Moving actors and approach geometry change the task without stationary respawns.

missions.title: Signal Workshop
missions.geometry: Two thin marked barriers and a broad clear workshop lane offer different routes after each opening.
missions.decision: Choose whether to open a shortcut, remove local interference, or catch prey before it crosses the new route.
missions.stations: Two eroders at different marked cells, one antenna, one guard. Each specialist appears once.

missions.title: Four Routes Home
missions.geometry: Four connected yards offer a permanent outer bypass, two timed cuts and a final open central return.
missions.decision: A sequence of distinct encounters changes the best return route; final moving prey rewards reading the whole board.
missions.stations: One source, one relay, one lane, one guard, all distinct; no repeated specialist station.
